picks.file: Theatri praecipvarvm totivs mvndi vrbivm - liber sextvs 1618 (97693430).jpg
picks.what: Engraving in Braun and Hogenberg, Civitates Orbis Terrarum, vol. 6
picks.who: Georg Braun and Frans Hogenberg, after Egidius van der Rye
picks.why: hand-colored copy, very high resolution; walled town with St. Michael’s Church; book page and orange frame trimmed

picks.what: View from the hills, hand-colored steel engraving
picks.why: color general view with St. Michael’s tower and the twin-towered Piarist church

picks.what: View from the Citadel hill, photograph (Fortepan)
picks.why: sharp general view over the old town to St. Michael’s Church; tree at right edge trimmed

picks.what: Panorama from the Citadel hill, photograph
picks.why: recent, sharp color panorama with St. Michael’s spire at center

gaps: P0, P2: no candidates. P3: none (#7 is dated about 1860, so P4). P4 has only #7.
notes: #1–#6 are copies of the same Braun and Hogenberg vol. 6 plate (1617); #5 is the authentic hand-colored 1618-edition copy from Polona, with no visible gutter; #2 and #3 are brighter colored copies at about 1500 px if a cleaner look is preferred. #7: Commons says about 1840, but it shows St. Michael’s neo-Gothic tower, built 1837–1862, and Kolb engraved Ludwig Rohbock’s views for Hunfalvy’s Ungarn und Siebenbürgen (1856–64), so I dated it about 1860; reviewer may want to confirm. #8 (1940) has soldiers and onlookers in the foreground; #10 and #11 (1961) are weaker than #9.
